claims: UFC Freedom 250 is scheduled for June 14, 2026.
UFC Freedom 250 is on the South Lawn of the White House, Washington, D.C.
UFC Freedom 250 features a six-fight main card.
UFC Freedom 250 is broadcast live on Paramount+.
UFC Freedom 250 celebrates Donald Trump's 80th birthday.
UFC Freedom 250 provides 85,000 free tickets for a nearby outdoor viewing experience at the Ellipse.
Zhang Mingyang vs. Alonzo Menifield is reported for the UFC Freedom 250 card.
Ilia Topuria (c) vs. Justin Gaethje (#1) is the Lightweight Title Bout on the UFC Freedom 250 main card.
Alex Pereira (c) vs. Ciryl Gane (#1) is the Interim Heavyweight Title Bout on the UFC Freedom 250 main card.
Sean O'Malley (#2) vs. Aiemann Zahabi (#6) is a Bantamweight Bout on the UFC Freedom 250 main card.
Mauricio Ruffy (#9) vs. Michael Chandler (#13) is a Lightweight Bout on the UFC Freedom 250 main card.
Bo Nickal vs. Kyle Daukaus is a Middleweight Bout on the UFC Freedom 250 main card.
Diego Lopes (#2) vs. Steve Garcia (#9) is a Featherweight Bout on the UFC Freedom 250 main card.
